Author: P.Sree Sudha

sentences.text:
Bench: P.Sree Sudha
The Honourable Smt. Justice P.Sree Sudha
 M.A.C.M.A.No.2534 of 2008
J U D G M E N T:

This Motor Accident Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act,
1989 against the Judgment and Decree dated 22.04.2008 passed in O.P.No.1010 of 2005 passed by the learned Chairman, Motor Vehicles Accidents Claims Tribunal-cum-III Additional District &
Sessions Judge (FTC), Nizamabad.

entities.text:
Motor Vehicles Accidents Claims Tribunal-cum-III Additional District &
Sessions Judge (FTC), Nizamabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 02. The Original Petition in O.P.No.1010 of 2005 was filed by appellant/petitioner claiming compensation of Rs.1,50,000/- for damages to the tractor and its trailer in the motor vehicle accident occurred on 08.03.2005.
03. The trial Court after considering the arguments of both sides, granted compensation only to an extent of Rs.40,000/-.
Aggrieved by the said Judgment and Decree, they preferred the present appeal.

04. As seen from the Judgment of the trial Court, the trial Court considered the evidence of PW2 who is licensed surveyor and issued report under Ex.A13 and he assessed loss at Rs.46,500/- and also filed Ex.A6 to A8 quotations and cash bills.
It was observed that the second respondent assessed the damage basing on the report of PW2 and he has no other source, because by that time the tractor and trailer were already repaired.

05. The trial Court, on considering the evidence adduced by both sides, observed that no extra premium was collected by the respondent No.2 for damage of third party and restricted the same to Rs.6,000/- and held that the first respondent is liable to pay Rs.40,000/- towards damages.
06. In view of the above, this Court finds no reason to interfere with the Judgment and Decree passed by the trial Court and this Motor Accident Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is liable to be dismissed.
07. Accordingly, this Motor Accident Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is dismissed.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
